stories.title: Man found dead on Flinders Island linked to shooting of police officer, Tasmanian authorities say
summary: Body of a man in his 20s discovered by police who were sent to investigate the shooting of an officer, who is in a serious but stable conditionGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastAn on-duty police officer has been shot and a man found dead nearby as police investigate two firearm incidents in a tiny Tasmanian town.The officer was working at Whitemark police station on Flinders Island, north-east of the island of Tasmania, when he was shot at about 9.45pm on Saturday night.

summary: Copini Beauty referred to New South Wales health regulators, while federal government says it is ‘deeply concerned’Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastAn Australian beauty company that promotes “clean” ingredients “free from skin irritants” has been referred to state health regulators after appearing to offer cigarettes to guests at a beachside lip gloss launch.Photos from an event held earlier in November at a venue in Bondi, Sydney show what appears to be loose cigarettes without health warnings on a tiered silver platter alongside a bowl of lip glosses.

stories.title: Australian neo-Nazis among far-right groups raising hundreds of thousands via global crowdfunding platform
summary: GiveSendGo has been accused of facilitating the financing of extremism, but the platform says it does not ‘condone racism, discrimination, hate speech, or violence of any kind’Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastAustralian neo-Nazis have raised hundreds of thousands of dollars on the global crowdfunding platform GiveSendGo, which has been accused of facilitating the financing of hate and extremism.Of the 68 Australian fundraisers on the site, the White Australia party has raised the fourth-highest amount of money with $200,000 for its high court battle to overturn its ban as a designated hate group.

stories.title: Louisiana man charged with killing woman on hiking trail and murdering co-worker with crossbow
summary: Jared Schurr arrested in Mississippi after Lizeht Rodriguez and Woodrow Scott died in otherwise unrelated killingsA man recently strangled a woman to death whom he did not know along a hiking trail north of New Orleans – then killed his co-worker with a crossbow two days later before being arrested in Mississippi after a police chase, authorities allege.Jared Schurr, 36, faces counts of second-degree murder in the killings of Lizeht Rodriguez, 24, and Woodrow Scott, 37, on 11 and 13 November, respectively, investigators said on Saturday.
